audit.why: Even lane (51.14% over 352 games). Fiora owns levels 1-3 with Lunge/Bladework vitals; Ryze has no dash and weak early mana. Difficulty 6/10 stands.
sources: kit: Fiora Q 400 range dash, Ryze no dash

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave Level 1 to 'Skill' and gave both late rows to Fiora, contradicting the packet chart and the page's own whys[6]/late text which say full-build Ryze takes over.
audit.why: packet levelChart reads Fiora/Fiora/Fiora/Skill/Skill/Ryze/Ryze; whys[0] states Fiora wins level 1 outright; whys[6] and late both hand the 2+ item window to Ryze.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Fiora; 2+ items -> Ryze, with phases[6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text treats Rune Prison as a root unconditionally and calls Realm Warp a personal roam tool.
audit.why: Riot text: Rune Prison 'damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' So a Rune Prison cast on an un-Fluxed Fiora is only a SLOW — Riposte blocks damage either way but only converts to a STUN when it blocks an immobilizing effect, i.e. the Flux-marked version. Realm Warp is 'creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported' — a delayed group portal, not a personal escape.
audit.corrected: Hold Riposte for Spell Flux -> Rune Prison; that pairing roots and is the only one your parry stuns. Ryze's root range is 615 vs your 400 Lunge.

audit.why: Rune Prison is the punishable cooldown at 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s; Overload is only 5s and resets off his other casts, so waiting out Q is not a plan.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ryze carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Ryze takes over: Flux into Rune Prison chains from 615 range, outside your 400 Lunge. Close the game before his scaling does.

edits.before: It's a skill window: bait the root with movement and you stomp, but eat a max-range E-Q without W up and the trade swings to him.
edits.after: It's a skill window: dodge Spell Flux and Rune Prison only slows you, but eat Flux then the 615-range root with W down and he burns you.

edits.before: Past two items Ryze chain-roots from outside Lunge range and his spell spam out-damages your Vital true damage — you can only parry one root, not the chain.
edits.after: Past two items Ryze lands Flux then Rune Prison from 615, outside your 400 Lunge, and Overload resetting off every cast out-damages you — one parry, not a chain.

edits.before: Ryze's window. Full mana-and-AP, his E-Q chain-roots from outside your Lunge range and the spell spam out-damages your Vital true damage faster than you can close. R realm warp also lets him roam lanes you can't dive.
edits.after: Ryze's window. Full mana-and-AP, Spell Flux into Rune Prison roots from 615 range, outside your 400 Lunge, and his spell spam out-damages your Vitals. Realm Warp is a delayed group portal — it flanks fights, it is not a solo escape.

edits.before: Hold W (Riposte) for his root — the E-marked Q or his W (Rune Prison) — so the parry becomes a STUN and you get a free Vital all-in
edits.after: Hold Riposte for Rune Prison cast while Spell Flux is on you — only that version roots, so only that parry returns a STUN and a free all-in

edits.before: That is Ryze's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Riposte stuns only if it blocks an immobilize; a Flux-less Rune Prison just slows.

notes: Chart rows 0 and 6 flipped to match the packet and the page's own prose. Row 5 (First item) is left alone: the packet says Ryze but phases[5].why and spikes[2] both call it a Fiora/neutral Ravenous Hydra window — flagged as a question rather than guessed. Realm Warp described correctly as a delayed group portal, not a personal roam.
